raw_text: Maintain an authentic, honest BCA student ML portfolio; avoid exaggerated claims or fake expertise. React + Vite + Tailwind. Design like a modern developer portfolio/AI dashboard; accents `#38BDF8`, `#22D3EE`; headings Space Grotesk, H1 for main headlines. Use reusable, modular, readable React components and clean folder structure. Mobile-first: responsive grids, readable mobile text, large touch buttons, lazy-loaded images; avoid unnecessary dependencies, complex code, heavy animations or distracting motion. Project: Titanic Survival Prediction; Kaggle Titanic Dataset; Logistic Regression; Python, Pandas, Scikit-Learn. Project pages: fade-in section reveal. Use icons for navigation, skills, project cards. Do NOT claim professional experience not actually achieved or research credentials not earned. “Try the Model” Titanic input form is optional; skip if complex. Done when UI is clean/modern, projects clear, portfolio authentic, mobile works, performance fast.
